correctness.rationale: Exact integer Stirling expansion and divisibility of (2r)! justify finite reduction modulo 2^r. Direct binomial expansion gives all eight c_j and B_j modulo 32 and the full mod-32 table. For odd j, j^(2^s)-1 equals 2^(s-1)(j^2-1) modulo 2^(s+4), by a uniform valuation bound on higher binomial terms; the mod-32 base then gives exact half-period differences. Doubling provides a period while the nonzero even-index defect forces minimality. The packaged exact-arithmetic verifier reproduces the critical finite certificate.

value.rationale: The result supplies the complete natural sequence of least eventual periods at all 2-power moduli, sharpening the originating bound by a factor two for all r>=4, and gives an explicit parity-sensitive obstruction to any shorter period. Its all-level lifting step is structural and the invariant is the central object of the motivating published problem, not an arbitrary finite slice.
